name: dsh-web-file-uploader
purpose: DeepSeek-style paperclip attach button in the composer input; uploads files to the DSH host with model-aware adaptation (native image blocks for multimodal models, file paths for text-only models).

dynamic.description: Current-session dynamic plugin: cordis_define + cordis_run. Uploads to <session workspace>/uploads/.

static.description: Persistent dsh bundle: dsh plugin --profile web add <package>. Uploads to $DSH_HOME/uploads via node:fs.
